authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein
title: Do LLM Attribution Metrics Transfer? Auditing Retrieval-Augmented Generation Evaluation Across Datasets and Constructs
summary: Practice often treats automatic metrics for attribution in LLM retrieval-augmented generation as interchangeable. We audit eight automatic scorers -- lexical, embedding, and BERTScore baselines alongside entailment/grounding-trained models (clean and FEVER NLI, the checker MiniCheck) -- across three evaluation constructs (provenance/topicality, generated-answer attribution, and fact-check entailment), asking whether any scorer transfers: stays within the 95% confidence interval of the best audited scorer on every dataset of a multi-dataset construct. In the construct with the most multi-dataset human-labeled coverage -- generated-answer attribution (AttributionBench's four source datasets, n = 1,610, with independent HAGRID, n = 2,150) -- none does: the per-dataset metric rankings invert (Kendall tau = -0.64, p = 0.031 on AttributedQA vs. LFQA), and an off-the-shelf NLI scorer that is best on short-claim AttributedQA (AUROC 0.90) collapses to AUROC 0.53 (chance) on long-form LFQA, where BERTScore wins (0.91); the flip is not a length or truncation artifact. This instability has a concrete decision cost: a naive "best-on-average" rule for choosing an evaluator fails leave-one-dataset-out (mean held-out regret 0.172 AUROC, worse than fixing one scorer), so metric choice must be validated on the target dataset rather than learned from others. A prompt-based LLM judge avoids the chance-level collapses the automatic scorers suffer (no LFQA collapse) but is not uniformly best, ~100x costlier, and non-deterministic -- relocating, not removing, the validation burden.

AI.tldr: 自动度量在LLM归因中不稳定，无统一最佳，需针对目标数据集验证。
AI.motivation: 探究自动评分器在不同评估结构中的可转移性，因为实践常将它们视为可互换。
AI.method: 审计8种自动评分器（词汇、嵌入、BERTScore、蕴含/基础训练模型），在三个评估结构（渊源/主题性、生成答案归属、事实核查蕴含）上测试，特别是生成答案归属多个数据集。
AI.result: 生成答案归属中，无评分器在所有数据集保持最佳；指标排名反转（Kendall tau=-0.64）；NLI在短声明AUROC 0.90但在长格式0.53；BERTScore长格式0.91；'best-on-average'规则失败，平均持出遗憾0.172 AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 度量选择必须在目标数据集上验证，不能从其他数据集学习；提示型LLM评判避免崩溃但非统一最佳且更昂贵。

fulltext_AI.summary: 该论文审计了八种自动归因指标（词汇、嵌入、BERTScore、NLI/检查器）在三种评估构建（来源/主题性、生成答案归因、事实核查蕴含）中的可迁移性。结果表明，在同一构建内，没有任何一种自动评分器能在所有数据集上保持最佳性能（例如，NLI评分器在AttributedQA上AUROC达0.90，但在LFQA上降至0.53）。论文强调指标选择必须在目标数据集上验证，不能跨数据集直接迁移。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions:
1. 跨数据集审计显示，指标排名在数据集间存在反转（如AttributedQA与LFQA的指标排名Kendall τ = -0.64）。
2. 提出操作性可迁移标准：指标需在所有数据集的95%置信区间内保持最佳。
3. 发现朴素“平均最优”选择规则在留一数据集上失败（平均遗憾0.172 AUROC）。
4. 提示基于LLM的评判更稳定，但成本高且非确定性，并未根本解决问题。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 审计8种指标：词汇Jaccard、MiniLM/MPNet余弦相似度、混合分数、BERTScore、clean MNLI NLI、FEVER NLI、MiniCheck。评估三个构建：(i)来源/主题性（ASQA、MS MARCO、HotpotQA排序准确率），(ii)生成答案归因（AttributionBench四个源数据集+HAGRID，AUROC），(iii)事实核查蕴含（VitaminC，AUROC）。使用留一数据集遗憾、Kendall W/τ统计、混淆证据压力测试等方法。
fulltext_AI.limitations:
1. 构建与领域偏移混淆，仅VitaminC作为域外基准。
2. 仅三个带有句子/声明级人类支持标签的数据集，均为英文。
3. 来源/主题性构建使用段落级标签，非句子级支持判断。
4. ERCR探针仅显示指标对输出变化不敏感，未证明真实改进被遗漏。
5. 分析仅限项目级，未验证指标不稳定是否导致系统排名反转。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 该工作直接挑战了实践中将归因指标视为可互换的常见做法。它表明，即使在同一构建内，指标表现也高度依赖数据集，盲目使用默认指标可能导致严重误判。研究结果为RAG评估确立了验证纪律：必须基于目标数据集进行指标选择，而不是依赖跨数据集平均值。这对于研究者和从业者选择评估指标具有重要指导意义。

authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein
title: When Retrieval Metrics Mislead: Measuring Policy Signal in Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
summary: Exact-match retrieval recall is often used as a proxy for whether a retriever supplies useful policy context to a downstream decision model. We test this proxy for pre-action policy classification in tau-bench using Qwen2.5-3B/7B classifiers. Under gold-policy conditioning, a compact structured state improves macro-F1 over raw trajectories by 0.13-0.17 after tuning. We then replace the benchmark-designated policy clause with the top-ranked clause retrieved from decision-time context. Although the exact governing clause is retrieved at rank 1 for only 7% of airline states, the primary 3B classifier obtains macro-F1 0.58 with retrieved clauses versus 0.60 with gold clauses (Delta=-0.02, task-cluster 95% CI [-0.23,+0.21]); mismatched-policy and no-policy controls score 0.32 and 0.21. We do not detect a macro-F1 difference between retrieved and gold clauses in this configuration, although the interval remains too wide to establish non-inferiority. The same qualitative pattern appears with a second retriever and at 7B, while varying across fine-tuning configurations. These results indicate that exact-match clause recall can underestimate downstream policy utility in this benchmark setting, motivating evaluation with retrieved policies in the classification loop rather than recall alone.

AI.tldr: Exact-match clause recall can underestimate downstream policy utility in tau-bench; retrieval-augmented classifiers achieve near-gold-policy performance.
AI.motivation: To test whether exact-match retrieval recall is a reliable proxy for the usefulness of retrieved policy context in downstream decision making.
AI.method: Used Qwen2.5-3B/7B classifiers on tau-bench for pre-action policy classification, compared macro-F1 under gold-policy conditioning, retrieved clauses, mismatched-policy, and no-policy controls.
AI.result: Retrieved-clause classifiers achieved macro-F1 0.58 vs 0.60 with gold clauses (Delta=-0.02, 95% CI [-0.23,+0.21]), while mismatched and no-policy controls scored 0.32 and 0.21; exact match recall was only 7%.
AI.conclusion: Exact-match clause recall can underestimate downstream policy utility, motivating evaluation with retrieved policies in the classification loop rather than recall alone.

fulltext_AI.summary: 本文研究在长周期工具使用代理中，精确匹配检索召回率是否可靠地衡量策略检索对下游决策模型的有用性。使用τ-bench-airline数据集和Qwen2.5-3B/7B分类器，作者发现尽管精确匹配召回率很低（@1仅7%），但检索到的策略条款与黄金条款相比在宏观F1上没有可检测的差异，而错误策略和没有策略则显著更差。这表明精确匹配召回率低估了下游策略效用，但结果对微调配置敏感。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 隔离了在黄金策略条件下决策状态表示的影响，显示结构化状态比原始轨迹能显著提高宏观F1。2. 系统地表征了精确匹配策略检索在两个τ-bench领域、多种查询构建和四种检索器下的性能，并使用黄金注入探针量化了将不匹配条款视为无信息的预测。3. 通过直接干预测试（替换政策输入为检索到的、不匹配的和缺失的），显示低精确匹配召回率可以与小黄金-检索差距共存，但效果随微调配置变化。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 使用τ-bench-airline的预动作决策状态（85个测试状态，15个任务），训练Qwen2.5-3B/7B分类器（LoRA，r=16，5个epoch，lr=5e-5）。表示变量包括：原始轨迹文本、掩码（工具输出替换为占位符）、结构化状态（显式提取请求、证据、适用策略、待定动作类）和原始+策略。策略检索使用MiniLM、bge-large等检索器，查询为请求+证据或轨迹上下文。评估指标为3-way宏观F1，置信区间通过非参数bootstrap计算。直接干预试验中将测试时的策略输入替换为检索到的top-1条款、黄金条款、不匹配条款或无条款。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 1. 构造效度：策略条款来自基准原生断言，而非真实政策文档，外部效度受限。2. 精确恢复不等于下游效用：显示低精确匹配召回率不必然导致低分类性能，但机制部分与检索条款长度混淆。3. 规模限制：仅两个领域（航空、零售），测试集小（85个状态），结果对微调配置敏感（黄金-检索差距在欠训练和过度训练时扩大）。4. 离线评估而非在线代理循环，且检索器为现成未训练。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 本研究质疑了在工具使用代理合规性分类中仅依赖精确匹配召回率作为检索质量度量的常见做法。通过直接测量检索策略在分类循环中的性能，发现低精确召回率不一定意味着下游效用低，因为不匹配的检索条款仍包含决策相关信息。这推动评估标准从仅检索召回率转向包含检索后分类性能的报告。对于构建可靠的政策约束代理系统，理解检索度量与下游模型性能之间的关系至关重要，尤其是在高安全性场景中。

title: RASC+: Retrieval-Constrained LLM Adjudication for Clinical Value Set Authoring
summary: Clinical value sets define the standardized terminology codes used in quality measurement, phenotyping, cohort construction, and clinical decision support. The recently introduced Retrieval-Augmented Set Completion (RASC) benchmark showed that direct zero-shot large language model (LLM) generation is poorly suited to this task: clinical code systems are large, version-controlled, and not reliably memorized by language models. We study a stage-wise alternative in which candidate-pool construction is optimized for recall and a constrained LLM adjudicator is optimized for candidate selection. On the full 3,744-value-set RASC test split, Qwen3-based retrieval with vocabulary-aware expansion and code-display rescue retrieval increases candidate-pool recall from the original RASC retrieval baseline of 0.553 to 0.730; on the held-out-publisher stratum, pool recall is 0.655. The higher-recall pool alone is not sufficient: applying the original SAPBert cross-encoder to this expanded pool gives full-test macro F1 of 0.287 and held-out-publisher macro F1 of 0.233. Replacing the stage-2 selector with blinded GPT-5 adjudication over the same pool increases full-test macro F1 to 0.549 and held-out-publisher macro F1 to 0.533. These results show that retrieval-constrained LLM adjudication can substantially improve value set completion while preserving the safety constraint that all returned codes must come from an auditable candidate pool.

AI.tldr: 提出检索约束的LLM裁决方法，通过候选池构建和LLM选择，在临床价值集完成任务上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 直接零样本LLM生成不适合临床代码系统，因为代码系统大、版本控制、难以记忆。
AI.method: 采用阶段式方法：先优化候选池构建（使用Qwen3检索、词汇感知扩展、代码显示救援检索），再用约束LLM裁决器（GPT-5）进行候选选择。
AI.result: 候选池召回率从0.553提升到0.730；使用GPT-5裁决后，全测试宏F1为0.549，保持出版商宏F1为0.533。
AI.conclusion: 检索约束的LLM裁决可以改善价值集完成，同时保持所有返回代码来自可审计候选池的安全性。

fulltext_AI.summary: 本文提出RASC+，一种检索约束的LLM裁决方法用于临床值集创作。通过优化两个阶段：候选池构建（使用Qwen3语义检索、词汇感知扩展和代码显示救援检索）和候选裁决（使用GPT-5进行受限选择），在RASC基准测试的完整测试集上，候选池召回率从0.553提升至0.730，整体宏F1从0.298提升至0.549，特别是在保留出版商（OOD）场景下，宏F1从0.233提升至0.533。该方法保持了输出必须来自可审计候选池的安全约束。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 构建了更高召回率的候选池，通过Qwen3嵌入、词汇感知图扩展和代码显示BM25检索，将完整测试召回率提升至0.730；2. 证明了检索约束的LLM裁决（GPT-5）能显著优于原有SAPBert交叉编码器（同一池上F1从0.287提升至0.549），尤其在分布外（OOD）场景下表现突出。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 阶段1（候选池构建）：使用Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B检索K=15个最近邻源值集，并合并其代码；对ICD-10-CM、RxNorm和SNOMED-CT进行词汇感知扩展（基于子类、兄弟、关系邻居等图结构），每个种子最多加3个新代码，每个词汇表最多加60个；通过BM25对代码显示字符串进行救援检索，取每词汇表前10个匹配并扩展。阶段2（候选裁决）：GPT-5作为约束裁决器，接收目标值集元数据和候选池（包括源代码、显示字符串、检索特征等），要求返回应包含的候选ID列表。协议采用盲化处理（移除OID、发布者、真代码等），池超过1200个候选时按确定性分块，最终预测为各块选择的并集。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 评估仅限于基准测试，未经前瞻性策展人验证；VSAC标签本身可能包含遗漏或错误。SAPBert比较未重新训练或调整阈值，可能不是最佳表现。未进行GPT-5的提示消融实验。大型候选池分块处理阻止了跨块比较。依赖专有GPT-5 API，可重复性受限于端点路由、模型版本和内容过滤；成本和延迟在部署中需考虑。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 该工作为临床值集创作提供了一种有效且安全的范式：通过分离检索和裁决阶段，利用检索约束LLM选择而非生成，既提高了性能又保持了可审计性。其分解方法允许独立优化各阶段，并为后续研究提供了可复用的基准和改进方向。特别在分布外泛化上的显著提升，表明该方法能适应不同发布者的创作风格，具有实际部署潜力。

title: MMed-Bench-IR: A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Multilingual Medical Information Retrieval
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in clinical settings increasingly requires multilingual retrieval against predominantly English evidence corpora. Multilingual medical retrieval demands three capabilities: cross-lingual alignment, concept discrimination, and evidence retrieval. However, existing benchmarks evaluate these only in isolation, leaving the interaction between biomedical expertise and multilingual coverage unmeasured. We introduce MMed-Bench-IR, a benchmark designed to disentangle these axes across 6 languages and three structurally heterogeneous tasks: (1) cross-lingual medical QA retrieval with 6,127 queries grounded in the Unified Medical Language System (UMLS), (2) concept discrimination over 4,975 confusion sets at three difficulty tiers, and (3) multilingual evidence retrieval for RAG with 2,040 quality-assured queries. The three tasks share zero concept and query overlap by design, ensuring that aggregate scores reflect genuine capability breadth. Evaluation of ten systems across six paradigm families reveals severe cross-lingual failure: biomedical encoders that score 0.818 nDCG@10 in English drop to 0.056 in Japanese, a gap that English-only benchmarks cannot detect.

AI.tldr: 提出了MMed-Bench-IR基准，用于评估多语言医学检索中的三个关键能力，发现现有系统在跨语言上表现严重下降。
AI.motivation: 现有基准单独评估多语言医学检索的各个能力，未测量生物医学专业知识与多语言覆盖的交互。
AI.method: 构建了包含6种语言、三个任务（跨语言医学QA检索、概念辨别、多语言证据检索）的基准MMed-Bench-IR，任务间无重叠。
AI.result: 评估10个系统，发现生物医学编码器在英语上nDCG@10为0.818，但在日语上仅为0.056，跨语言失败严重。
AI.conclusion: 多语言医学检索需要更好的跨语言能力，英语专用基准无法检测此类差距。

fulltext_AI.summary: MMed-Bench-IR 是一个多语言医疗信息检索基准，覆盖英语、西班牙语、法语、日语、中文和俄语6种语言和3种书写系统，包含三个异构任务：跨语言医疗问答检索（6,127个查询）、概念区分（4,975个混淆集）和多语言证据检索（2,040个查询），三个任务无概念和查询重叠。评估了10个系统（6个范式家族），发现生物医学编码器在日语上的nDCG@10从英语的0.818降至0.056，公平性差距达0.76，揭示了英语单语基准无法检测的跨语言失败模式。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions:
1. 首个联合评估多语言对齐和生物医学专业化的基准，覆盖6种语言和3种书写系统。
2. 三个任务零概念和查询重叠，确保总分反映真实能力广度。
3. 系统评估揭示一致性范式层级，概念区分是最难的词汇瓶颈（BM25与最佳模型差距+0.38）。
4. 暴露生物医学编码器在非拉丁语系上的严重跨语言失效，公平性差距比多语言模型高3倍。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 基准包含三个任务：任务1基于UMLS本体构建跨语言医疗QA检索，5种语言6,127个查询，语料库2,552篇；任务2从UMLS构造三个难度层级（同义词、兄弟、相关）的混淆集，共4,975个，查询4,143个；任务3将BioASQ 13b的340个英语问题翻译为5种语言，经概念保真度和反向翻译质量保证，保留1,708个查询，语料库80,049篇英语片段。评价指标为MMed-IR（三个任务得分的宏观平均）和语言间公平性差距。基线包括BM25、SapBERT、BGE-M3、ColBERT-XM等10个系统，及微调的MMed-Embed。
fulltext_AI.limitations:
1. 任务3中日语和中文的翻译质量保守估计（LLM审计准确率78-80%）。
2. 任务2语料库仅6,340个词项，限制了相关难度层级的统计能力（仅325个混淆集）。
3. 仅覆盖6种语言，缺少阿拉伯语、印地语等。
4. 任务1排除法语（CUI标记不足）。
5. 未包含最新的LLM嵌入模型（如GritLM）。
6. 所有任务使用自动相关判断，可能对资源稀缺语言存在偏差。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 该基准首次系统评估多语言医疗信息检索中的跨语言对齐、概念区分和证据检索能力，揭示了现有模型在非英语语言上的严重性能崩塌，强调在临床应用中需要语言公平性。它为开发在多种语言上均有效的检索系统提供了标准化评估工具，有助于缩小AI医疗工具的语言鸿沟，改善非英语人群的健康结果。

title: AVOC: Enhancing Hour-Level Audio-Video Understanding in Omni-Modal LLMs via Retrieval-Inspired Token Compression
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models have achieved remarkable progress in short-form audio-video understanding, yet long-form audio-video comprehension remains challenged by limited context windows and severe information redundancy. To address these bottlenecks, we propose AVOC, a framework for long-form audio-video understanding in Omni-modal Large Language Models. AVOC introduces a learnable token compression module between the modality encoders and the LLM backbone. We reframe multimodal token compression as a top-$K$ retrieval problem: given a fixed context budget, the module must retrieve a compact subset of tokens that best supports answering the user query. We draw inspiration from three classical Information Retrieval criteria for selecting informative units from a large candidate pool: relevance, importance, and diversity. AVOC instantiates each criterion as a tailored mechanism for audio-video understanding, and integrates them into a unified retrieval-style compression pipeline. Experiments show that AVOC achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-form audio-video benchmarks, surpassing the second-best model by 4.9 and 5.5 points in average accuracy on OmniVideoBench and LVOmniBench, respectively. Moreover, AVOC maintains robust performance on Audio-Video Needle-in-a-Haystack task at durations up to one hour.

AI.tldr: 提出AVOC框架，通过将令牌压缩视为top-K检索问题并集成相关性、重要性、多样性标准，实现长形式音频-视频理解在OmniModal LLM中的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有长形式音频-视频理解受限于有限上下文窗口和严重信息冗余。
AI.method: 提出AVOC框架，在编码器和LLM之间引入可学习令牌压缩模块，将多模态令牌压缩建模为top-K检索问题，并基于相关性、重要性、多样性三种信息检索标准设计压缩机制。
AI.result: 在OmniVideoBench和LVOmniBench上分别比第二名高4.9和5.5个平均准确率点，在长达1小时的Audio-Video Needle-in-a-Haystack任务上保持稳健性能。
AI.conclusion: AVOC通过检索式令牌压缩有效解决了长形式音频-视频理解的瓶颈，实现了最先进性能。

fulltext_AI.summary: AVOC是一种用于多模态大语言模型的框架，通过将令牌压缩重新定义为top-K检索问题，并融合信息检索中的相关性、重要性和多样性三个准则，实现了小时级音视频理解。实验表明在多个长音视频基准上达到最优性能。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 将多模态令牌压缩视为top-K检索问题，设计了可学习压缩模块，实例化了三个经典IR准则：文本引导的交叉注意力用于查询相关性，双向视频-音频交叉注意力用于内在重要性，时间感知最大边际相关性用于局部多样性。2. 基于该模块构建了AVOC，能够处理小时级音视频流，实现整体理解和细粒度检索。3. 在OmniVideoBench和LVOmniBench上分别以4.9和5.5个平均精度点超越第二名，并在长达一小时的音视频大海捞针任务中保持稳健。
fulltext_AI.method_details: AVOC在模态编码器和LLM主干之间插入可学习压缩模块。首先将音视频编码为统一的多模态令牌序列。然后，计算每个令牌的两种分数：文本引导的交叉注意力分数（相关性）和双向视频-音频交叉注意力分数（重要性），并进行Z-score归一化后平均得到组合分数。接着，采用时间感知最大边际相关性（TA-MMR）进行多样化选择，在局部时间窗口内惩罚冗余，独立为每个模态分配预算并贪婪选择。最后，选中的令牌按时间顺序重排后输入LLM。训练使用两阶段策略和Gumbel-Softmax实现可微分选择。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 论文未明确讨论局限性，但可能包括：对固定令牌预算的依赖，TA-MMR窗口大小和多样性系数需要调整，以及训练数据覆盖有限可能影响泛化性。此外，压缩模块在极低保留率下可能丢失关键信息。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 该工作通过检索启发的令牌压缩，显著提升了多模态大模型对超长音视频的理解能力，在长视频问答、细粒度检索等任务上取得突破，推动了面向真实世界小时级多模态内容的应用发展。

title: On the Stability of Prompt Ranking in Large Language Model Evaluation
summary: Prompt-based interaction has become a dominant paradigm for using large language models (LLMs), where multiple candidate prompts are evaluated and the top-ranked one is selected for downstream use. This workflow implicitly assumes that prompt rankings are stable under minor variations in evaluation conditions. In this paper, we systematically study prompt ranking stability under common sources of variability, including random seeds and limited evaluation subsets. Across three open-weight LLMs and two benchmark tasks, we find that while overall rank correlations are often moderate to high, the identity of the top-performing prompt frequently changes, leading to unreliable selection decisions. To address this issue, we propose a simple stability-aware selection strategy based on a lower confidence bound, which accounts for both performance and variance. Our results show that this approach improves robustness in unstable settings while remaining competitive in more stable regimes. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for evaluation uncertainty in prompt selection and LLM benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 研究提示排名在评估条件下的稳定性，发现排名不稳定导致选择不可靠，提出基于置信下限的稳定感知选择策略以提高鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 当前提示选择隐含假设排名稳定，但实际中排名易受随机种子和评估子集影响，导致选择不可靠。
AI.method: 提出稳定感知选择策略，基于下限置信界同时考虑性能与方差。
AI.result: 该方法在不稳定设定下提升鲁棒性，在稳定设定下保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 提示选择与LLM基准测试中应重视评估不确定性的影响。

fulltext_AI.summary: 本文系统研究了大型语言模型（LLM）中提示排名在不同评估条件（如随机种子和子集大小）下的稳定性。研究发现，尽管整体排名相关性中等偏高，但最佳提示的身份频繁变化，导致选择不可靠。作者提出了一种基于下置信界的稳定性感知选择策略，在噪声环境下提升了鲁棒性，同时在高稳定场景下保持竞争力。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: （1）首次系统研究在真实评估变异性下的提示排名稳定性；（2）揭示高排名相关性并不保证稳定的提示选择；（3）提出基于下置信界的简单稳定性感知选择方法，在不牺牲稳定场景性能的情况下提升噪声环境下的鲁棒性。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 使用三个开放权重模型（Mistral-7B-Instruct、Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）和两个基准任务（GSM8K、MMLU）。评估变异性来自不同随机种子和子集大小（50、100、200）。采用Spearman ρ、Kendall τ、Top-k一致性等指标衡量排名稳定性。提出基于平均性能减去置信度惩罚的下置信界选择策略，并与均值选择比较。使用留一种子法评估选择鲁棒性。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 仅关注两个基准任务和每个任务20个固定提示；未来需要扩展到更多任务、提示族和评估设置（如少样本提示、生成式评估）；对z参数的综合敏感性分析留待未来工作。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 提示评估应被视为统计估计问题而非确定性比较，尤其是有限评估预算下。该工作强调了考虑评估不确定性在提示选择和LLM基准测试中的重要性，并为实际部署提供了低成本的鲁棒性改进方案。

title: DREAM: Dense Retrieval Embeddings via Autoregressive Modeling
summary: Dense retrieval embedding models are a fundamental component of modern retrieval-based AI systems. Most dense retrievers are trained with contrastive objectives, which require labeled positive and negative document pairs that are often costly and difficult to obtain. In this work, we investigate whether the autoregressive next-token prediction objective of a large language model (LLM) can provide supervision for dense retrieval. The intuition is simple: if a document contains information relevant to a query, conditioning on that document should make the target output easier for the LLM to predict. A key challenge is that the next-token prediction loss is computed inside the LLM, while the retriever is a separate embedding model. To address this challenge, we propose DREAM (Dense Retrieval Embeddings via Autoregressive Modeling), which injects retriever-generated query-document similarity scores into selected attention heads of a frozen LLM. During training, these scores determine how much attention each candidate document receives while the LLM predicts the target output. The resulting prediction loss provides gradients for retriever training through the attention mechanism. We evaluate DREAM on retrieval benchmarks BEIR and RTEB using embedding backbones ranging from 0.5B to 3B parameters. DREAM consistently outperforms existing baselines across different model scales. These results demonstrate that DREAM provides a promising approach for training dense retrievers through autoregressive modeling.

AI.tldr: DREAM通过将检索器生成的相似度分数注入冻结LLM的注意力头，利用自回归预测损失训练密集检索器，在多个基准上取得更好性能。
AI.motivation: 现有密集检索器需要大量标注数据，本文探索是否可以用LLM的自回归下一个词预测目标为检索提供监督。
AI.method: 提出DREAM，将检索器生成的查询-文档相似度分数注入冻结LLM的注意力头，在LLM预测目标时控制对候选文档的注意力，通过预测损失反向传播梯度训练检索器。
AI.result: 在BEIR和RTEB基准上，使用0.5B到3B参数的嵌入骨干，DREAM一致优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: DREAM表明通过自回归建模训练密集检索器是一种有前景的方法。

fulltext_AI.summary: 本文提出DREAM，一种通过自回归下一词预测目标训练密集检索器的方法。它利用冻结的LLM作为评判，将检索器的查询-文档相似度分数注入到选定的注意力头中，使LLM在预测目标输出时受检索结果影响，从而通过预测损失训练检索器。在BEIR和RTEB基准上，DREAM在不同模型规模下均优于现有基于LLM监督的检索方法。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions:
1. 提出利用自回归下一词预测目标直接训练密集检索器，无需对比学习中的正负样本对。
2. 设计通过注意力机制将检索器分数注入冻结LLM的框架，实现端到端梯度传播。
3. 发现查询聚焦头是有效的注入接口，而随机头则效果很差。
4. 实验证明该训练范式在0.5B到8B模型规模上均有效，且生成的嵌入空间具有更好的均匀性。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 训练实例包含查询q、候选文档d_1,...,d_K和目标段落y。密集检索器f_ϕ计算查询和文档的L2归一化嵌入，相似度为内积。相似度经softmax归一化为文档权重p_ϕ(d_j|q)。使用Zhang等人(2025a)的方法预选查询聚焦头（top 16），这些头的注意力原本就关注查询与候选文档的相关性。在训练时，将文档权重注入到选定头的查询令牌行：原始注意力归一化后乘以文档权重，再与原始注意力混合（可学习门控）。仅修改选定头的查询令牌行，其他保持不变。冻结LLM预测目标段落，损失为目标段落的交叉熵。梯度通过修改后的注意力流回检索器，文档权重竞争导致无负例也能推动不相关文档的得分下降。
fulltext_AI.limitations:
1. 依赖预选的查询聚焦头，需要额外的离线计算，且不同LLM可能头分布不同。
2. 训练数据需生成查询，引入生成噪声和领域偏差（仅基于Wikipedia）。
3. 冻结的LLM作为评判可能不是最优，更新LLM会降低信号质量。
4. 候选文档数量固定（默认16），可能影响大规模候选时的效果。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 这项工作证明了自回归下一词预测可以作为密集检索训练的有效监督信号，提供了一种替代传统对比学习的方法。它降低了对人工标注正负样本的依赖，利用语言模型自身的预测能力指导检索器训练。DREAM展示了跨模型规模的可扩展性，并启发了未来利用生成式损失训练检索模型的研究方向。

title: CompressKV: Semantic-Retrieval-Guided KV-Cache Compression for Resource-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
comment: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2508.02401
summary: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly constrained by the memory footprint and decoding cost of key-value (KV) caches, limiting sustainable deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Existing KV cache eviction methods typically apply heuristic token scoring over all heads in GQA-based LLMs. These methods ignore the different functionalities of attention heads, leading to the eviction of critical tokens and thus degrading the performance of LLMs. To address this issue, we propose CompressKV, a resource-efficient KV-cache compression framework for GQA-based LLMs. Instead of aggregating attention scores from all heads, CompressKV identifies Semantic Retrieval Heads (SRHs) that capture both the initial and final tokens of a prompt and semantically important mid-context evidence, and uses them to select tokens whose KV pairs should be retained. Furthermore, CompressKV allocates cache budgets across layers according to offline estimates of layer-wise eviction error. Experiments on LongBench and Needle-in-a-Haystack show that CompressKV consistently outperforms existing KV-cache eviction methods across memory budgets. Notably, it preserves over 97\% of full-cache performance using only 3\% of the KV cache on LongBench question-answering tasks and achieves 90\% accuracy with just 0.7\% KV storage on Needle-in-a-Haystack. These results demonstrate an improved resource--performance trade-off for long-context LLM inference. Our code is publicly available at:

AI.tldr: CompressKV通过识别语义检索头和分层预算分配，在极低KV缓存下保持高推理性能，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存驱逐方法忽略注意力头的不同功能，导致关键标记被驱逐，性能下降，需要更智能的压缩框架。
AI.method: CompressKV识别语义检索头（SRHs）以选择保留关键标记的KV对，并根据离线估计的逐层驱逐错误分配缓存预算。
AI.result: 在LongBench上，仅用3%缓存保留97%以上全缓存性能；在Needle-in-a-Haystack上，用0.7%缓存达到90%准确率。
AI.conclusion: CompressKV在长上下文LLM推理中实现了改进的资源-性能权衡。

fulltext_AI.summary: CompressKV 是一种针对分组查询注意力（GQA）大型语言模型的高效 KV 缓存压缩框架。它通过识别语义检索头（SRH）来避免流式头主导的 token 驱逐，并基于离线估计的逐层压缩误差进行自适应缓存分配。实验表明，在 LongBench 和 Needle-in-a-Haystack 基准上，CompressKV 在极低缓存预算下（如 3% KV 缓存保留 97% 性能）显著优于现有方法。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions:
提出语义检索头（SRH）的概念及其识别方法，通过聚合注意力在答案跨度上的权重而非依赖精确 top-k 命中，更鲁棒地捕获语义相关头。
基于 SRH 设计 token 选择机制，由每层 top-k SRH 共同决定保留的 KV 对，避免流式头的过度影响。
提出误差感知的层自适应缓存分配策略，离线计算每层压缩前后注意力的 Frobenius 范数误差，按比例分配缓存预算，不增加在线推理开销。
在多种模型（Llama-3.1、Mistral、Qwen2.5）和基准上验证了有效性，与多种现有方法相比取得一致提升，并能与预填充加速、KV 量化等方法正交集成。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 1. **语义检索头识别**：使用校准数据集，对每个头计算其在生成正确答案 token 时对答案跨度内所有 token 的注意力总和作为 SRH 分数，选取每层 top-k 头。2. **token 选择**：对每层，将各 SRH 的注意力矩阵在观察窗口内求和并跨 token 池化，再取平均，保留得分最高的 N 个 token 的 KV 对。3. **层自适应分配**：在极端压缩下，离线计算每层全缓存与压缩缓存在解码阶段的注意力输出差异的 Frobenius 范数（归一化），根据误差比例分配总缓存预算，并设置每层上下限（32 和 3 倍平均预算）。整个分配离线完成，推理时固定。
fulltext_AI.limitations:
依赖额外的校准数据集来识别 SRH，可能需要针对不同模型重新收集。
目前仅针对 GQA 架构的 LLM 设计，未验证在其他注意力机制（如 MHA）上的效果。
层分配基于离线误差估计，可能无法适应测试时数据分布的变化。
实验限于英文和常见基准，对极端长上下文（>128K）或特定领域可能有偏差。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV 缓存的内存和计算开销是部署瓶颈。CompressKV 通过语义感知的 token 选择和离线误差引导的分配，在保持高精度的同时大幅降低缓存占用（如 0.7% 缓存达 90% 检索准确率），为资源受限环境下的高效推理提供了实用方案，并推动了可持续 AI 发展。

title: Breaking the Filter Bubble: A Semantic Pareto-DQN Framework for Multi-Objective Recommendation
comment: IEEE International Conference on Responsible Artificial Intelligence (IRAI) - 2026
summary: Recommender systems often induce filter bubbles and semantic homogenization by monolithically optimizing for immediate user engagement. Standard single-objective models, including traditional Deep Q-Networks, are ill-equipped to navigate the trade-offs between platform retention and critical societal values like information diversity and provider fairness. To address these limitations, we introduce a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that formalizes recommendation as a semantic multi-objective Markov decision process. By integrating high-fidelity semantic embeddings with a Pareto-DQN agent, our architecture treats engagement, diversity, and fairness as distinct, non-aggregable reward signals, avoiding the pitfalls of static reward scalarization. Empirical evaluations on the MovieLens small dataset shows that our hypervolume based action selection disrupts the feedback loops responsible for semantic collapse. By sustaining high state-trajectory variance, the Pareto-DQN effectively maps the Pareto frontier, achieving gains in auxiliary societal objectives with only marginal impacts on engagement. This work provides a path toward intrinsically aligned, responsible recommender systems.

AI.tldr: 提出基于 Pareto-DQN 的多目标强化学习推荐框架，通过超体积动作选择平衡参与度、多样性和公平性，在 MovieLens 数据集上实现了社会目标增益且保持参与度。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统单目标优化导致过滤气泡和语义同质化，标准 DQN 等模型无法权衡平台留存与信息多样性、公平性等社会价值。
AI.method: 将推荐形式化为语义多目标马尔可夫决策过程，使用高保真语义嵌入与 Pareto-DQN 智能体，将参与度、多样性、公平性作为独立奖励信号，采用基于超体积的动作选择。
AI.result: 在 MovieLens 小数据集上，该方法打破了语义崩溃反馈循环，维持高状态轨迹方差，有效映射帕累托前沿，在辅助社会目标上取得显著增益，仅对参与度有微小影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为构建内在一致、负责任的推荐系统提供了路径。

fulltext_AI.summary: 本文提出一种基于语义Pareto-DQN的多目标推荐框架，将推荐形式化为语义多目标马尔可夫决策过程（MOMDP），利用语义嵌入和Pareto-DQN来平衡用户参与度、信息多样性和提供者公平性。实验表明，该方法能有效打破过滤气泡，在仅轻微降低参与度的情况下显著提升多样性和公平性。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions:
1. 提出多目标强化学习推荐框架，将参与度、多样性和公平性作为独立奖励信号，避免静态标量化。
2. 集成语义嵌入（all-MiniLM-L6-v2）实现零样本泛化，缓解冷启动问题。
3. 设计Pareto-DQN架构，包含奖励逼近器和连续Pareto曲面估计，通过超体积最大化进行动作选择。
4. 在MovieLens数据集上验证了过滤气泡的缓解效果，通过用户嵌入方差量化语义同质化的破坏。
5. 分析了责任代价，展示了在参与度小幅下降下多样性和公平性的相对增益。
fulltext_AI.method_details:
语义嵌入：使用Sentence-BERT将项目文本（标题、类型、标签）编码为384维L2归一化向量。
状态表示：用户状态为历史高分项嵌入的质心。
动作空间：分层候选池，70% KNN近邻项+30%长尾项，大小100。
转移动力学：指数移动平均更新状态，参数α控制偏好漂移速度。
奖励函数：参与度=sigmoid(状态·项目)；多样性=1-余弦相似度(状态,项目)；公平性=1/log(1+累积曝光次数)。
网络架构：输入为状态和项目嵌入拼接（768维），分为两个MLP：奖励逼近器（3层，预测即时奖励向量）和连续Pareto曲面估计（输入额外目标坐标，预测剩余目标可达值）。
动作选择：对每个候选，通过向量加和计算预期回报集，使用超体积指标评估Pareto支配性，选择超体积最大的动作。
训练：使用经验回放、MSE损失、Adam优化器、ϵ-greedy探索。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 实验仅在MovieLens小数据集上进行，未在电商、新闻等多样化领域验证；基于离线模拟，假设确定性偏好漂移，未来需考虑随机模型；未与更多多样性感知基线（如其他MORL方法）进行比较。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 该工作提供了一种可扩展的多目标推荐方法，能够在保持参与度的同时有效促进多样性和公平性，打破过滤气泡。通过将伦理目标整合进强化学习框架，推动了负责任推荐系统的发展，具有实际部署价值。

title: Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System?
comment: Paper list available at: this https URL . Source code available at: this https URL
summary: Memory for large language model (LLM) agents has rapidly evolved from simple retrieval-augmented mechanisms into a data management system that supports persistent information storage, retrieval, update, consolidation, and dynamic lifecycle governance throughout agent execution. Despite this evolution, existing evaluations still benchmark agent memory mainly through end-to-end task success metrics (e.g., F1, BLEU), while treating the underlying system as a monolithic black box. As a result, critical system-level concerns, including operational costs, architectural trade-offs across memory modules, and robustness under dynamic knowledge updates, remain insufficiently explored. In this paper, we present a systematic experimental study of agent memory from a data management perspective. We propose an analytical framework that decomposes agent memory into four core modules: memory representation and storage, extraction, retrieval and routing, and maintenance. Under this framework, we evaluate 12 representative memory systems and two reference baselines across five benchmark workloads spanning 11 datasets. Our extensive end-to-end evaluation shows that no single architecture dominates across all scenarios; instead, effectiveness depends heavily on how well the memory structure aligns with the workload bottleneck. Furthermore, through fine-grained ablation studies, we quantify their individual effects on representation fidelity, retrieval precision, update correctness, and long-horizon stability. Finally, we reveal cost-performance trade-offs under realistic workloads, showing localized maintenance is more cost-efficient than global reorganization. Based on these findings, we identify promising directions towards building truly agent-native memory systems. The code is publicly available at .

AI.tldr: 本文从数据管理视角系统研究了LLM agent记忆，提出四模块分析框架，评估12个系统发现架构与工作负载瓶颈的对齐决定效果，并揭示成本-性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅用端到端指标衡量记忆，忽略系统级问题如操作成本、架构权衡和动态更新鲁棒性，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出将agent记忆分解为表示与存储、提取、检索与路由、维护四个模块的分析框架，评估12个记忆系统和两个基线，跨越5个基准工作负载和11个数据集，并进行细粒度消融研究。
AI.result: 无单一架构在所有场景占优，有效性取决于记忆结构与工作负载瓶颈的对齐；消融研究量化各模块对表示保真度、检索精度、更新正确性和长期稳定性的影响；本地维护比全局重组更成本高效。
AI.conclusion: 基于发现，识别了构建真正agent原生记忆系统的有希望的方向。

fulltext_AI.summary: 本文从数据管理视角对LLM代理记忆系统进行了系统性实验研究。提出了一个将代理记忆分解为表示与存储、提取、检索与路由、维护四个核心模块的分析框架，并在五个基准工作负载、11个数据集上评估了12个记忆系统和两个基线。结果表明没有单一架构在所有场景中占优，记忆结构需与工作负载瓶颈对齐；细粒度消融实验量化了各组件的影响；揭示了成本-性能权衡。最后指出了构建真正代理原生记忆系统的方向。
fulltext_AI.key_contributions: 1. 提出代理记忆系统的四模块分解框架（表示与存储、提取、检索与路由、维护）及结构化分类法。2. 在统一测试床上对12个记忆系统进行端到端评估，涵盖五个工作负载和11个数据集，从任务有效性、检索保真度、动态更新鲁棒性、长期稳定性和操作成本五个维度分析。3. 通过细粒度消融实验量化各技术组件的性能权衡。4. 揭示关键发现：无通用架构、证据对齐的重要性、结构化方法在跨会话推理中的优势、更新鲁棒性差异、长期稳定性挑战、成本-性能权衡、组件级信息丢失。
fulltext_AI.method_details: 论文将代理记忆系统建模为四元组⟨ℛ, 𝒮, 𝒬, 𝒰⟩，分别对应记忆表示与存储、提取、检索与路由、维护。实验评估12个系统（如Mem0、Zep、MemGPT、A-MEM等）及两个基线（Long Context和Embedding RAG），使用五个工作负载：LoCoMo（长对话QA）、LongMemEval（跨会话长记忆）、DB-Bench（程序化执行）以及其他两个（文中未详述但提及共5个）。指标包括Exact Match、ROUGE-L、LLM Judge Accuracy、Recall@K、操作成本等。通过控制变量进行组件级消融实验。
fulltext_AI.limitations: 评估局限于文本、结构化及参数化表示，未覆盖多模态记忆；端到端评估依赖任务成功指标，可能忽略系统级细节；受限于现有开源系统版本和配置；未充分探讨可扩展性和大规模部署问题；部分基准数据集规模较小或合成性较高。
fulltext_AI.why_it_matters: 本文首次从数据管理系统角度系统评估代理记忆，揭示了架构与工作负载的对齐重要性，为未来设计任务自适应的记忆系统提供了实证基础。其细粒度组件分析有助于指导模块优化，成本-性能权衡发现对生产部署具有实践意义。研究指出了当前系统在更新鲁棒性、长期稳定性和操作成本方面的不足，为构建真正的代理原生记忆系统指明了方向。

title: L3Cube-MahaPOS: A Marathi Part-of-Speech Tagging Dataset and BERT Models
summary: Part-of-Speech (POS) tagging is a foundational NLP task underpinning machine translation, information extraction, and syntactic parsing. Despite Marathi being spoken by over 83 million people and ranking among the top twenty most spoken languages worldwide, it remains severely under-resourced in annotated corpora and standardised evaluation benchmarks. Marathi presents unique challenges for computational modelling owing to its rich morphology, relatively free word order, lack of capitalisation conventions, and pervasive code-mixing with Hindi and English. We introduce L3Cube-MahaPOS, a gold-standard POS tagging dataset for Marathi comprising 32,354 manually annotated sentences drawn from news text. Annotation was performed entirely manually by a team of Marathi-proficient annotators following a 16-tag Universal Dependencies-aligned scheme. A structured preprocessing pipeline covering Unicode normalisation, Devanagari-aware tokenisation, and noise filtering ensures label consistency across all splits. We benchmark the dataset across six model families spanning HMM, CRF, BiLSTM, BiLSTM+CharCNN, MuRIL, and the Marathi-specific transformer MahaBERT-v2. The best system achieves 88.67\% token-level accuracy and a macro-F1 of 81.67% over 15 evaluated tag classes. We release the dataset, annotation guidelines, and trained model checkpoints to foster further research in Marathi NLP.

AI.tldr: L3Cube-MahaPOS is a manually annotated Marathi POS dataset of 32,354 sentences with 16 tags, benchmarked across six model families. The best system (MahaBERT-v2) achieves 88.67% accuracy and 81.67% macro-F1.
AI.motivation: Marathi is under-resourced despite high speaker count and presents unique NLP challenges due to rich morphology, free word order, lack of capitalization, and code-mixing. A gold-standard POS dataset is needed to advance Marathi NLP.
AI.method: 32,354 sentences from news text were manually annotated by Marathi-proficient annotators using a 16-tag Universal Dependencies scheme. A preprocessing pipeline with Unicode normalization, Devanagari-aware tokenization, and noise filtering was applied. Benchmarking used HMM, CRF, BiLSTM, BiLSTM+CharCNN, MuRIL, and MahaBERT-v2.
AI.result: The best system achieves 88.67% token-level accuracy and 81.67% macro-F1 over 15 evaluated tag classes.
AI.conclusion: The dataset, annotation guidelines, and trained checkpoints are released to foster further research in Marathi NLP.

title: SURGELLM: Rethinking Multi-Task Evaluation through Task-Aware Feature Gating with Class-Balanced Normalization
comment: Proceedings of the 6th Workshop on Trustworthy NLP (TrustNLP 2026), ACL 2026, San Diego, California, USA. Available at this https URL
summary: Fine-tuned encoders deployed across heterogeneous NLP tasks face three compounding problems: mismatched inductive biases, class-imbalance corruption of feature statistics, and no mechanism to condition attention on external lexical knowledge. We introduce \textbf{\surgellm}, a unified transformer framework that addresses each with a dedicated lightweight module: a \emph{surgical feature gate} (learned per-dimension sigmoid over curated lexical indicators and \texttt{[CLS]}; provably degenerates to identity when features are uninformative), \emph{task-conditioned prefix tokens} (quantized feature values and task identity prepended to every input), and \emph{Instance-Weighted Normalization} (IWN; removes class-prior bias from gate statistics). We prove an excess-risk bound linking gate benefit to \emph{surgical feature alignment}. Across four tasks, SST-2, multi-hop retrieval, LLM-prompt attribution, and authorship detection, covering 17,830 examples and eleven model variants over three seeds, the IWN variant achieves macro-F1 \textbf{0.940} ($+0.036$ over the strongest non-IWN baseline; $+0.130$ on authorship detection). A random-vocabulary control ($-0.028$ avg.\ F1) confirms gains are lexical, not parametric. Code, vocabularies, and a $99.5\%$-recovery auto-extraction recipe are released.

AI.tldr: Surgellm是一个统一的transformer框架，通过手术特征门、任务条件前缀和实例权重归一化来解决编码器在异质NLP任务中的三个问题，在四个任务上获得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 微调编码器在异质NLP任务中面临三个问题：不匹配的归纳偏差、类别不平衡对特征统计的破坏、缺乏机制条件化注意力于外部词汇知识。
AI.method: 提出了Surgellm框架，包含三个轻量模块：手术特征门（learned per-dimension sigmoid）、任务条件前缀令牌（量化特征值和任务ID）、实例权重归一化（消除类先验偏差）。并证明了一个超额风险界。
AI.result: 在SST-2、多跳检索、LLM提示归因和作者检测四个任务上，IWN变体达到宏F1 0.940，比最强非IWN基线高0.036，在作者检测上高0.130；随机词汇控制确认增益来自词汇。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效，并发布了代码、词汇表和99.5%恢复率的自动提取配方。

title: Transformer-Based Language Models Across Domain Verticals: Architectures, Applications and Critical Assessment
summary: Transformer-based language models have become the default substrate for natural language processing and the pace of new releases has made it hard for practitioners to separate durable ideas from the noise of incremental announcements. This review works at two levels. At the level of mechanism, we organise the main transformer families into a working taxonomy, covering encoder-only, decoder-only, encoder-decoder, long-context, permutation-based, and generator-discriminator variants. We then extend the discussion to post-2023 developments that changed the picture in practice: instruction tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback, direct preference optimisation, mixture-of-experts scaling, retrieval augmentation and the current flagship model families from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral and DeepSeek. At the level of use, we survey deployments across healthcare, finance, legal, education, customer service, creative writing and scientific work. Based on this we link each to the specific capabilities that make a transformer the appropriate tool. The contribution of this paper is a critical assessment that is based on the survey. We compare architectures on four axes that matter to deployment decisions, we quantify the trade-off between parameter count and energy cost. We also discuss how alignment methods, data provenance and benchmark saturation change what it means to call a model "state of the art". The final section lists the research questions that we think deserve more attention.

AI.tldr: 对Transformer模型家族及其应用的综合综述，提供了分类、比较和批判性评估。
AI.motivation: 帮助从业者从大量发布中区分出有持续价值的想法。
AI.method: 构建工作分类学，涵盖多种Transformer变体，并延伸讨论后期发展；调查在多个领域的部署。
AI.result: 提供了架构比较的四个维度，量化了参数数量与能源成本之间的权衡，并讨论了影响模型评价的因素。
AI.conclusion: 总结了需要更多关注的研究问题，并给出批判性评估。

title: Escaping the Self-Confirmation Trap: An Execute-Distill-Verify Paradigm for Agentic Experience Learning
summary: Experience-driven self-evolution is critical for large language model (LLM) agents to improve through open-world interaction. However, existing experience learning methods mostly rely on single-agent loops, where the same agent executes tasks, summarizes outcomes, and determines memory content. This setup makes agents vulnerable to the Self-Confirmation Trap: wrong-but-self-consistent trajectories are misidentified as successful experience, leading to cumulative errors during retrieval and reuse. To address this issue, we propose EDV, an Execute-Distill-Verify framework for reliable experience learning. In the Execute stage, multiple heterogeneous agents explore the same task space in parallel to generate diverse candidate trajectories. In the Distill stage, a dedicated third-party agent comparatively analyzes these trajectories to produce candidate experiences, reducing executor-centric summarization bias. In the Verify stage, the execution group validates candidates via a consensus mechanism, and only approved experiences are written into shared or private memory. By decoupling the three stages, EDV transforms experience learning from isolated self-reflection into collaborative construction, filtering erroneous and noisy content before memory insertion. We evaluate EDV on three challenging long-horizon benchmarks: tau2-bench, Mind2Web and MMTB. Results show EDV consistently outperforms strong baselines, validating that reliable experience construction is essential for robust agent self-evolution. Our code is available at .

AI.tldr: EDV proposes a three-stage framework (Execute-Distill-Verify) for reliable experience learning in LLM agents, decoupling execution, distillation, and verification to overcome the self-confirmation trap from single-agent loops.
AI.motivation: Existing single-agent experience learning methods are vulnerable to the Self-Confirmation Trap, where wrong-but-self-consistent trajectories are misidentified as successful experiences, leading to cumulative errors.
AI.method: EDV consists of Execute (multiple heterogeneous agents explore in parallel to generate diverse trajectories), Distill (dedicated third-party agent comparatively analyzes trajectories to produce candidate experiences), and Verify (execution group validates candidates via consensus mechanism before memory insertion).
AI.result: EDV consistently outperforms strong baselines on three long-horizon benchmarks: tau2-bench, Mind2Web, and MMTB.
AI.conclusion: Reliable experience construction is essential for robust agent self-evolution.

title: Privacy-Preserving RAG via Multi-Agent Semantic Rewriting: Achieving Confidentiality Without Compromising Contextual Fidelity
comment: This full manuscript contains 23 pages and has been formally accepted for publication in Information Processing & Management (Elsevier IPM). Tao Fang is the corresponding author
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation enhances large language models by incorporating external knowledge, but deploying it in sensitive scenarios risks privacy leakage via malicious prompts. To address this, we propose a multi-agent framework that sanitizes retrieved content through semantic rewriting. By employing three specialized agents for privacy extraction, semantic analysis, and reconstruction, our approach collaboratively removes sensitive identifiers while preserving the semantic core. We evaluate the framework on the ChatDoctor and Wiki-PII datasets across six large language models. Experimental results demonstrate a significant reduction in privacy leakage under targeted attacks. For instance, we reduced targeted information exposure in LLaMA-3-8B from 144 instances in the baseline to just 1. Furthermore, we maintain strong contextual fidelity with a BLEU-1 score of 0.122, outperforming the existing SAGE method's 0.117. Finally, the framework operates as an asynchronous preprocessing module, introducing no additional latency to online inference, as all rewriting is executed as a one-time offline preprocessing step. To promote reproducibility, the source code of this work is publicly available at .

AI.tldr: 提出一个多智能体框架，通过语义重写净化检索内容，在降低隐私泄露的同时保持语义完整性。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成在敏感场景部署时，面临通过恶意提示导致隐私泄露的风险。
AI.method: 采用三个专门智能体（隐私提取、语义分析、重建）协同工作，对检索内容进行语义重写，移除敏感标识符并保留语义核心。
AI.result: 在ChatDoctor和Wiki-PII数据集上，针对LLaMA-3-8B的隐私泄露从144例降至1例，BLEU-1得分0.122优于SAGE的0.117，且作为离线预处理模块不增加推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 该框架显著降低隐私泄露，保持上下文化忠实性，且不引入额外延迟。

title: Quantifying Prior Dominance in RAG Systems
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds Large Language Models in external knowledge, yet current evaluations rely on discrete heuristics that suffer from ''epistemic blindness'' - failing to distinguish genuine contextual information extraction from parametric memory recall. To address this, we introduce the Normalized Context Utilization (NCU) metric, leveraging continuous token log-probabilities across zero-shot, oracle, and adversarial conditions to strictly quantify contextual information gain. Evaluating architectures ranging from 1.5B to 72B parameters alongside a proprietary commercial API reveals that for strict factual extraction (without Chain-of-Thought reasoning), traditional scaling laws exhibit extreme diminishing returns: highly efficient Small Language Models (SLMs) match or outperform high-capacity architectures. Furthermore, we demonstrate that ``Prior Dominance'' correlates with model scale and proprietary alignments. The evaluated commercial API not only overrode explicit external evidence in nearly half of adversarial conflicts, but also frequently suffered from systemic confidence collapse (Negative Transfer) when its parametric priors were contradicted. Our findings highlight the structural epistemic advantage and superior contextual adherence of SLMs in strict extraction workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出NCU指标评估RAG，发现小语言模型在严格事实提取中优于大模型，商业API存在先验主导和负迁移。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG评估依赖离散启发式，存在“认知盲区”，无法区分上下文信息提取与参数化记忆。
AI.method: 引入NCU指标，利用连续token对数概率在零样本、oracle和对抗条件下量化上下文信息增益，评估1.5B-72B参数架构及商业API。
AI.result: 严格事实提取中传统缩放定律出现极端收益递减，小模型匹配或超越大模型；先验主导与模型规模和专有对齐相关；商业API在对抗冲突中覆盖外部证据并出现置信度崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 小语言模型在严格提取工作流中具有结构认知优势和更好的上下文遵循。

title: Does My Embedding Reflect That $A = B$? Evaluating Mathematical Equivalence in Embedding Models
summary: Because mathematics is highly abstract, a single statement can take very different forms depending on what subfield it is framed in. There are many examples where breakthroughs occurred after researchers discovered that a question had already been answered in a different field. At the same time, the growth of new resources related to formalization has increased the need for tools that enable efficient and reliable navigation between mathematical 'languages' (e.g., from Lean to natural language). In this paper, we investigate whether current embedding models capture mathematical equivalence. To do this, we introduce the Mathematically Equivalent but Lexically Different Pairs (MELD) Dataset, a collection of mathematically equivalent statements that are expressed in very different language. We show that current state-of-the-art embedding models tend to group statements by the terminology used to make them instead of the underlying math. Motivated by this, we propose a contrastive approach to learning embeddings of mathematical text that focuses on aligning informal statements with different formalizations. Our experiments demonstrate that this leads to improvements not only on informal-formal retrieval tasks but also on MELD, which only contains natural language statements.

AI.tldr: 提出MELD数据集并发现现有嵌入模型根据术语而非数学内容分组数学语句；通过对比学习对齐非正式与正式表述，改善了嵌入表示。
AI.motivation: 数学高度抽象导致同一陈述在不同子领域形式不同，现有嵌入模型未能捕捉数学等价性，而是按术语分组，这阻碍了跨领域知识发现。
AI.method: 构建MELD数据集，包含数学等价但词汇不同的语句对；提出对比学习方法，拉近非正式表述与不同正式表述的嵌入距离。
AI.result: 对比学习在非正式-正式检索任务及MELD数据集上均优于现有模型，证明能更好地捕捉数学等价性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能有效改善数学文本嵌入，使模型关注底层数学内容而非表面术语，有助于跨领域数学导航。

title: Towards Version-aware Operations and Transaction Memories for Multi-layer MeMo
comment: Accepted by MeMo Workshop on Mechanistic Interpretability & Neuro-symbolic Approaches by-design, Rome (Italy), 24/6/2026
summary: MeMo proposes language models with explicit multi-layer correlation matrix memories (CMMs), where memorization, retrieval, and forgetting are architectural operations. This paper asks how such memories can reduce the need for retraining when knowledge changes. For changes expressible as MeMo memory associations, the model's accessible knowledge can be updated by editing explicit memories rather than retraining the whole model. We propose a version-aware operation layer in which high-level operations such as replace, obsolete, keep-history, rollback, and trace are compiled into MeMo-native primitive calls over sequences and tokens. The key observation is that a version-aware operation is rarely a single MeMo association. It is an ordered transaction of primitive edits, for example forgetting one sequence-token chain, memorizing another, preserving a historical chain, and recording an inverse program. The framework introduces two auxiliary CMMs: a Version CMM (V-CMM) for mapping version transitions to transaction handles, and a Transaction CMM (T-CMM) for storing reusable change contents and inverse programs. It supports both direct sequence-level edits and structured diff-level inputs, and outlines an evaluation route for update success, rollback, traceability, locality, and transaction reuse.

AI.tldr: 提出MeMo模型，通过版本感知操作层和辅助CMM实现知识更新而不需重新训练。
AI.motivation: 减少知识变化时重新训练整个模型的需要。
AI.method: 版本感知操作层将高级操作编译为MeMo原语，并引入版本CMM和事务CMM。
AI.result: 概述了评估更新成功、回滚、可追溯性、局部性和事务重用的路线。
AI.conclusion: 通过编辑显式记忆可有效更新模型知识，支持替换、废弃、历史保留等操作。

title: Cross-Lingual Exploration for Parametric Knowledge
summary: Parametric knowledge in Large Language Models is not equally accessible across languages. As a result, standard inference techniques often struggle to surface localized facts, leading to failures in cross-lingual knowledge transfer and consistency. In this work, we investigate techniques for accessing hidden factual knowledge by exploring cross-lingual prompting strategies. We identify four inherent dimensions of cross-lingual exploration that directly govern parametric knowledge retrieval and evaluate them on multilingual factual benchmarks covering 17 typologically diverse languages. Our results demonstrate that cross-lingual exploration significantly improves knowledge transfer and factual recall, representing a more efficient compute Pareto frontier than native-language scaling. Furthermore, we observe corresponding improvements in cross-lingual consistency, exceeding what can be explained by accuracy gains alone. Overall, our work establishes multilingual prompt exploration as a highly effective inference-time strategy for unlocking latent parametric knowledge.

AI.tldr: Cross-lingual prompting strategies effectively improve knowledge retrieval and consistency in multilingual LLMs.
AI.motivation: Parametric knowledge in LLMs is not equally accessible across languages, leading to failures in cross-lingual knowledge transfer and consistency.
AI.method: Investigate cross-lingual prompting strategies by identifying four inherent dimensions of exploration and evaluating on multilingual factual benchmarks covering 17 languages.
AI.result: Cross-lingual exploration significantly improves knowledge transfer and factual recall, achieving a more efficient compute Pareto frontier than native-language scaling, and also improves cross-lingual consistency beyond accuracy gains.
AI.conclusion: Multilingual prompt exploration is established as a highly effective inference-time strategy for unlocking latent parametric knowledge.

title: MEMPROBE: Probing Long-Term Agent Memory via Hidden User-State Recovery
summary: Long-term memory promises LLM agents that grow more capable across sessions, maintaining an accurate, evolving understanding of the user that interaction forms. In practice, however, this memory is evaluated mostly through downstream behavior, such as later answers, personalization quality, or task success, which tests that understanding only indirectly and leaves the memory artifact itself largely unaudited. We argue that long-term memory should instead be evaluated as an auditable post-interaction artifact: after ordinary assistance, what structured user state can be reconstructed from the memory the agent leaves behind? We instantiate this view in MEMPROBE, a benchmark in which a memory-equipped agent assists simulated users, each carrying a hidden, taxonomy-anchored user-state bank, across a trajectory of leak-controlled tasks, after which that bank is reconstructed from the agent's resulting memory under both full-store and top-k access. Built on synthetic ground truth for efficient, scalable measurement, MEMPROBE spans 50 simulated users with 31 hidden dimensions each (1,550 recovery targets) and tests 5 representative memory systems. Testing state-of-the-art memory agents, we find that successful assistance and recoverable memory behave as distinct capabilities. Task completion nearly saturates, even for a memoryless baseline, while category-balanced recovery stays moderate (about 0.6) and drops further under top-k retrieval. MEMPROBE is the first benchmark to study memory recovery directly, reconstructing the user state a system retains and scoring it against ground truth. We see recovery as a concrete objective for future memory agents to optimize, and MEMPROBE as a step toward an environment where agents are trained to remember their users, growing more faithful the longer they know them.

AI.tldr: 提出MEMPROBE基准，通过重建用户状态直接评估长期记忆，发现协助能力与记忆恢复能力分离。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆评估间接且缺乏审计，主张应作为可审计的后交互工件评估。
AI.method: 构建MEMPROBE基准，使用模拟用户和隐藏用户状态库，通过任务轨迹让代理生成记忆，再重建用户状态进行评估。
AI.result: 成功协助和可恢复记忆是不同能力；任务完成饱和但记忆恢复中等（约0.6），top-k下更低。
AI.conclusion: MEMPROBE首个直接研究记忆恢复的基准，为优化目标，迈向更忠实记忆的代理。

title: Age of LLM: A Strategic 1v1 Benchmark for Reasoning, Diplomacy and Reliability of Large Language Models under Fog of War
comment: 25 pages including appendices, 8 figures, 4 tables; appendices include verbatim system prompt and engine resolution pseudocode. All correlations reported with p-values, 95% bootstrap confidence intervals and Spearman's rho; includes a Steiger test and Bradley-Terry fit
summary: We introduce Age of LLM, a turn-based 1v1 benchmark in which two LLMs face off on a 13x7 grid to destroy the enemy base. Three stressors are deliberate: fog of war, full diplomacy (messages, ceasefires, ultimatums; uranium kept secret), and a reliability dimension where every turn must follow a strict JSON schema and an illegal action is silently discarded. The engine is private and each match uses a fresh random map seed and opponent, mitigating the data contamination that affects public benchmarks. Models receive a (near) rule-only prompt with no build-order advice (two tactical seed phrases were present during data collection; see Section 2.7). We benchmark 15 reasoning models across 54 matches and 5,258 actions. Findings: (1) the nuclear rush dominates (78% on the rules-coherent v0.11+ sub-corpus; 85% corpus-wide) with a sole-launcher signature that is largely mechanical under secret-simultaneous launch rules, not a cognitive deterrence failure; (2) military conquest is rare but faster (12.3 vs 18.9 turns); (3) diplomacy is prolific yet almost never consummated; (4) ~58% of illegal actions are fog/state errors, making the illegal-action rate a measure of belief-tracking; (5) -- the least established, and the only one we label exploratory -- a weak link associates reliability with winning. The corpus is small, unbalanced and not side-swapped, so the ranking is a preliminary descriptive view, not a contribution. Beyond ranking, the turn-by-turn traces of actions and messages make the corpus a lens on how LLMs reason under adversarial uncertainty -- their belief-tracking, spontaneous deception, and per-model cognitive "personas" -- which we frame as a future research direction. We release the replay format, an isometric viewer and all replays; engine source on request.

AI.tldr: 提出一个新的LLM基准测试Age of LLM，通过战争游戏评估模型在对抗不确定性下的表现，发现核rush策略主导，但可靠性与获胜关联弱。
AI.motivation: 现有公开基准易受数据污染，且缺乏对LLM在复杂对抗环境（如信息不完整、欺骗）中推理能力的评估。
AI.method: 设计13x7网格的回合制1v1战争游戏，包含战争迷雾、完全外交和可靠性维度三种压力因素，使用规则提示，对15个推理模型进行54场比赛，共5258个动作，记录所有动作和消息。
AI.result: 五个发现：(1) 核rush主导（78-85%）；(2) 军事征服罕见但更快；(3) 外交频繁但很少达成；(4) 约58%非法动作源于迷雾/状态错误；(5) 可靠性与获胜之间存在弱关联。
AI.conclusion: 数据集小且不平衡，排名仅为初步描述，但轨迹和消息为研究LLM在对抗不确定性下的推理（如信念追踪、欺骗）提供了视角，并作为未来研究方向。

title: Matching Tasks to Objectives: Fine-Tuning and Prompt-Tuning Strategies for Encoder-Decoder Pre-trained Language Models
summary: Prompt-based learning has emerged as a dominant paradigm in natural language processing. This study explores the impact of diverse pre-training objectives on the performance of encoder-decoder pre-trained language models across generation and question answering tasks, with a focus on commonsense knowledge retrieval and completion. We highlight the benefits of incorporating multiple objectives during both pre-training and fine-tuning stages. We introduce the Match Task to Objective (MTO) framework and methods for determining the appropriate objective for a given task. This framework offers automated methods to prepare task-related data for adaptation through unsupervised training, based on the identified objective. In the fine-tuning stage, we design novel templates that align with the objectives of the pre-training and adaptation stages. When aligned with task requirements, these strategies can achieve a performance gain of over 120\% compared to conventional methods in few-shot settings. They significantly outperform related works in few-shot settings and exceed the baseline even in full-dataset scenarios. Furthermore, we extend this approach to include prompt-tuning methodologies, providing guidance for more effective soft prompt engineering and optimization. Our strategies significantly enhance prompt-tuning performance as well. These insights hold substantial value, precisely guiding the selection and optimization of models customized for specific tasks. Code is available at

AI.tldr: 提出MTO框架，通过匹配预训练目标与任务，结合特定模板，在少样本场景下显著提升生成和问答任务性能。
AI.motivation: 探索不同预训练目标对编码器-解码器模型在常识知识检索和完成等任务上的影响，以指导模型选择和优化。
AI.method: 提出Match Task to Objective (MTO)框架，自动确定任务对应目标并准备无监督训练数据；设计对齐预训练和适应阶段目标的模板；并扩展至提示调优方法。
AI.result: 在少样本设置中性能提升超过120%，超越相关工作和基线；在完整数据集上也优于基线；提示调优性能显著增强。
AI.conclusion: 这些策略为特定任务的模型选择和优化提供了精确指导，具有重要价值。

title: Ground Then Rank: Revisiting Knowledge-Based VQA with Training-Free Entity Identification
comment: Accepted by ACL 2026 Findings. Project page this https URL
summary: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) requires grounding visual queries to external knowledge beyond directly observable content in images. While recent multi modal large language models (MLLMs) show strong perceptual abilities, they struggle on KB-VQA tasks requiring groundings from both fine-grained entity and evidence levels. Most existing multi-modal retrieval augmented generation (MM-RAG) methods tightly couple entity discrimination and section-level evidence ranking into a single re-ranking stage, leading to high cost and limited generalization. In this work, we revisit existing MM-RAG solutions from a workflow perspective and argue both entity-level and fact-level groundings are key bottlenecks. We observe that although MLLMs often fail under open-ended entity naming, they can better identify the correct entity when selecting from a small set of candidate names. Based on this insight, we propose a simple and training-free identify-before-answer IBA framework that decouples entity identification from section-level re-ranking. Our approach prompts an MLLM to select high-confidence entities using only candidate names, followed by an off-the-shelf textual re-ranker for evidence selection. Experiments on Encyclopedic-VQA and InfoSeek show that our method consistently outperforms fine-tuned multi-modal re-ranking baselines while reducing training and inference complexity. Additional analyses reveal that the improvements arise not only from better entity identification, but also from selecting more informative evidence once correct entity is fixed. Our implementation is made public to ease reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 提出IBA框架，通过解耦实体识别和证据重排序，提升KB-VQA性能，降低复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有MM-RAG方法将实体区分和证据排名耦合在一阶段，导致高成本和有限泛化；MLLMs在开放实体命名时失败，但在候选集中选择更好。
AI.method: 提出训练无关的IBA框架，先利用MLLM从候选名称中挑选高置信度实体，再使用现成文本重排序器进行证据选择。
AI.result: 在Encyclopedic-VQA和InfoSeek上，该方法优于微调的多模态重排序基线，降低训练和推理复杂度，改进源于更好的实体识别和更信息性的证据选择。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法简单有效，可复现，为KB-VQA提供了一种解耦实体与证据推理的新思路。

title: UOL@IDEM at BEA 2026 Shared Task 1: Neural Fusion and Feature-Rich Modeling for L1-Aware Vocabulary Difficulty Prediction
comment: Published at BEA2026, 21st Workshop on Innovative Use of NLP for Building Educational Applications, at ACL, July 2026, San Diego
summary: This paper describes UOL@IDEM's closed-track submission to the BEA 2026 shared task on L1-aware vocabulary difficulty prediction. We model the task as regression and train separate systems for Spanish, German, and Mandarin Chinese\footnote{Below we use \emph{Chinese} for brevity.}. Our system combines multilingual contextual representations with engineered features capturing frequency, surface form, retrieval evidence, semantic alignment, cognate similarity, and masked-language-model predictability. Development results show consistent gains over the official closed-track baselines, with sentence-embedding encoders such as BGE-M3, multilingual E5, and LaBSE performing best. Official submissions achieve RMSE scores of 1.132, 1.037, and 0.891 for Spanish, German, and Chinese, respectively. Feature analysis identifies frequency as the most stable predictor, while contextual predictability, form similarity, retrieval, and semantic features provide complementary L1-sensitive signals. Error analysis shows strong ranking performance but weaker calibration for the easiest items, which are often overpredicted. See

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合多语言上下文表示和工程特征的回归方法，用于L1感知词汇难度预测，在西班牙语、德语和中文上取得良好效果。
AI.motivation: 针对词汇难度预测中语言特异性（L1感知）的需求，需要开发跨语言适用的模型。
AI.method: 将任务建模为回归，结合多语言上下文表示（如BGE-M3、E5、LaBSE）与多种工程特征（频率、表面形式、检索证据、语义对齐、同源相似性、掩码语言模型可预测性），并针对每个语言训练单独系统。
AI.result: 在西班牙语、德语和中文上分别取得RMSE 1.132、1.037、0.891，超过官方基线；频率是最稳定的预测因子，其他特征提供互补的L1敏感信号；错误分析显示对简单项目过度预测，排名性能良好但校准较弱。
AI.conclusion: 多语言上下文表示与工程特征结合可有效进行L1感知词汇难度预测，频率是关键特征，但需进一步改进校准以处理简单项目。

title: Paying to Know: Micro-Transaction Markets for Verified Product Information in Agentic E-Commerce
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Vision paper, under review
summary: Commercial NLP treats the shopping chatbot as a recommender or a conversion tool: its job is to match a user to a catalogue entry and close a sale. We argue that the arrival of agent-native micro-payment rails (e.g., x402, AP2) changes what is scarce. When the buyer is an autonomous agent that can investigate exhaustively, the bottleneck is no longer matching products but acquiring trustworthy, decision-relevant information about them. We envision agentic e-commerce as a micro-transaction market for verified information: buyer agents spend fractions of a cent to progressively unlock seller- and reviewer-supplied data -- service histories, third-party test reports, bills of materials, audited sales and support metrics -- paid for a la carte under a freemium model, with reviewer trust scored reputationally. We sketch the architecture of such a market and argue that it rewards genuine product quality and yields truer competition than ranking-based storefronts. We then translate the vision into concrete NLP problems -- cost-optimal information acquisition, data pricing and negotiation, real-time entity resolution, grounded value exchange, and privacy-preserving persona modelling -- and argue that these, not chat fluency, deserve the field's attention.

AI.tldr: 提出基于微支付的代理电商市场，强调NLP应关注信息获取等问题而非聊天流畅性。
AI.motivation: 当前商业NLP将购物聊天机器人视为推荐或转化工具，但代理原生微支付改变了稀缺性，瓶颈从匹配产品变为获取可信信息。
AI.method: 描绘了一个基于微交易的验证信息市场架构，并转化为成本最优信息获取、数据定价与谈判、实时实体解析、基于价值交换、隐私保护的人物建模等NLP问题。
AI.result: 论证该市场奖励真正的产品质量，并产生比基于排名的店面更真实的竞争。
AI.conclusion: 这些NLP问题值得领域关注，而不是聊天流畅性。

title: SHERLOC: Structured Diagnostic Localization for Code Repair Agents
summary: LLM agents solve repository-level coding tasks through multi-turn tool use, but utilize half their budget on locating faults before editing. Dedicated localization frameworks have emerged, yet are still evaluated as file retrieval rather than actionable diagnosis, producing locations without the diagnostic context a repair agent needs. We introduce SHERLOC (Structured Hypothesis-driven Exploration and Reasoning for Localization), a training-free framework pairing a reasoning LLM with compact repository tools and self-recovery, without fine-tuning or multi-agent orchestration. SHERLOC reaches state-of-the-art localization across model scales: 84.33% accuracy@1 on SWE-Bench Lite and 81.27% recall@1 on SWE-Bench Verified; at ~30B parameters, it matches or outperforms other agentic methods. Injecting our locations and diagnostic findings into repair agents yields, on average, +5.95 pp resolve rate on SWE-Bench Verified while cutting localization and total tokens by 36.7% and 23.1%.

AI.tldr: SHERLOC是一个无需训练、结合推理LLM与紧凑仓库工具和自我恢复的框架，在SWE-Bench定位任务上达到SOTA，并有效提升修复代理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在代码库级任务中浪费一半预算用于定位错误，而专用定位框架仅评估文件检索，缺乏诊断上下文，无法满足修复代理需求。
AI.method: SHERLOC采用结构化假设驱动探索与推理，结合推理LLM、紧凑仓库工具和自我恢复，无需微调或多代理编排。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench Lite上达到84.33% accuracy@1，SWE-Bench Verified上81.27% recall@1；约30B参数下匹配或超越其他方法；注入定位和诊断后使修复代理解决率平均提升5.95个百分点，同时减少定位令牌36.7%和总令牌23.1%。
AI.conclusion: SHERLOC实现了可操作的代码库级定位，显著提升后续修复效率，是一种高效、轻量级的解决方案。

title: ReM-MoA: Reasoning Memory Sustains Mixture-of-Agents Scaling
summary: Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) architectures improve inference-time scaling by organizing multiple LLM agents into layered reasoning pipelines. However, existing MoA variants fail to sustain gains as depth increases, exhibiting degradation, early plateauing, or saturation. We propose ReM-MoA, a memory-augmented MoA framework that sustains scaling through two mechanisms: (1) a Ranked Reasoning Memory that persistently stores and ranks reasoning traces from all layers using a comparative Reviewer Agent, and (2) a Curated Diversified Memory Routing scheme that exposes different agents to distinct combinations of successful and failed traces, preserving exploration diversity while propagating high-quality reasoning. We further introduce an optional multi-domain Reviewer distillation pipeline that improves ranking quality through frontier-model supervision. Across five reasoning benchmarks spanning math, formal logic, code, knowledge, and commonsense, ReM-MoA consistently outperforms prior MoA variants across both depth and width scaling, and its advantage widens with depth, establishing structured cross-layer reasoning memory as a key missing mechanism for scalable multi-agent inference.

AI.tldr: 提出ReM-MoA，通过排名推理记忆和策展多样化记忆路由机制，实现MoA架构在深度和宽度上的持续缩放，显著优于先前变体。
AI.motivation: 现有Mixture-of-Agents (MoA)架构在增加深度时出现性能退化、早期平台或饱和现象，无法维持推理时间缩放的增益。
AI.method: ReM-MoA框架包含两个核心机制：(1) 排名推理记忆（Ranked Reasoning Memory），使用比较Reviewer Agent存储并排名各层推理轨迹；(2) 策展多样化记忆路由（Curated Diversified Memory Routing），向不同代理暴露成功和失败轨迹的组合以保持探索多样性。此外，引入可选的多域Reviewer蒸馏流程提升排名质量。
AI.result: 在数学、形式逻辑、代码、知识和常识等五个推理基准上，ReM-MoA在不同深度和宽度缩放下均一致优于先前MoA变体，且优势随深度增加而扩大。
AI.conclusion: 结构化跨层推理记忆是实现可扩展多代理推理的关键缺失机制。

title: Governed Shared Memory for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary: Multi-agent LLM environments require robust mechanisms for shared knowledge management. This paper formalizes the fleet-memory problem and identifies four foundational failure modes: unauthorized leakage, stale propagation, contradiction persistence, and provenance collapse. To address these, we define explicit systems-level primitives: scoped retrieval, temporal supersession, provenance tracking, and policy-governed memory propagation. These primitives are implemented in MemClaw, a production multi-tenant memory service, and evaluated via ArgusFleet, a reproducible harness testing four governance dimensions. Rather than a baseline comparison, this study measures a live production service, emphasizing real-world architectural insights and negative results. Key Evaluation Results Provenance: Successfully reconstructed 100% of depth-four derivation chains with correct writer identity at sub-second per-hop latency. Propagation: Demonstrated high intra-fleet visibility with zero cross-fleet leakage. Under strong write mode, write-to-visible latency was optimized to a single search round-trip. Production Architectural Issues Discovered Asymmetric Scope Enforcement: Tenant isolation held, but sub-tenant scope was initially bypassed on direct GET-by-id requests for agent-scoped credentials (disclosed and remediated during the study). Pipeline Ordering Conflict: While contradiction supersession works for admitted writes, a synchronous near-duplicate gate can prematurely reject contradictory writes before the asynchronous contradiction detector can evaluate them. Conclusion: Long-context retrieval alone is insufficient for production multi-agent memory. Governed shared memory demands explicit systems-level abstractions, and live evaluation is vital to expose enforcement and pipeline-ordering failures missed by design-only treatments.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了多智能体LLM环境中的舰队记忆问题，定义了四个系统级原语以避免四种故障模式，在MemClaw中实现，并通过ArgusFleet评估，揭示了现实架构问题，得出结论：受控共享记忆需要明确的系统级抽象。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM环境需要稳健的共享知识管理机制。
AI.method: 形式化舰队记忆问题并识别四种故障模式，定义系统级原语（范围检索、时间更替、来源追踪、策略驱动的记忆传播），在MemClaw中实现，通过ArgusFleet在四个治理维度上评估生产服务。
AI.result: 来源追踪成功重建100%深度为4的推导链，传播表现为高内舰队可见性和零交叉舰队泄漏；发现了不对称范围执行和流水线排序冲突两个架构问题。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠长上下文检索不足以支撑生产多智能体记忆；受控共享记忆需要明确的系统级抽象，并且实际评估对发现设计遗漏的强制和流水线排序失败至关重要。

title: Agentic AI for Bilevel Long-Term Optimization of Policy-Driven Physical Layer Systems
summary: Network operators' changing policies, service requirements, and stringent real-time constraints render existing methods designed with fixed objectives and constraints ineffective. This paper presents Agentic long-term performance optimization (Agentic-LTPO), a nested bilevel optimization framework that can be applied to adaptive physical layer problem configuration. The key idea is to employ agentic AI to generate upper-level configurations in a bilevel optimization structure, where evolving operator policies, environment summaries, and historical experiences are translated into structured lower-level optimization problem configurations. The lower level solves the problems with updated configurations for real-time physical-layer decisions. Considering cell-free MIMO beamforming as a use case, we embody Agentic-LTPO by designing a new multi-agent decision process with retrieval-augmented experience-based verification in the upper level, together with a closed-form beamformer in the lower level. Experiments demonstrate that Agentic-LTPO exhibits strong adaptability to dynamic operator policies and effectively enhances the system's long-term performance by 57.2% compared to traditional methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于agentic AI的双层优化框架Agentic-LTPO，用于自适应物理层配置，在无蜂窝MIMO波束成形中提升长期性能57.2%。
AI.motivation: 网络运营商政策变化、服务需求和实时约束使传统固定目标方法失效。
AI.method: 采用嵌套双层优化，上层通过agentic AI生成配置，下层求解实时物理层决策；针对无蜂窝MIMO波束成形，设计多智能体决策过程和检索增强验证，结合闭式波束成形器。
AI.result: 实验表明对动态政策适应性强，长期性能比传统方法提升57.2%。
AI.conclusion: Agentic-LTPO有效增强系统长期性能，适用于动态环境。

title: CAVEWOMAN: How Large Language Models Behave Under Linguistic Input and Output Compression
summary: "Talk short. Drop grammar. Save token." This caveman style is widely promoted as a way to cut inference cost, but whether it actually saves anything depends on which channel (the user's prompt or the model's response) is being compressed. We present Cavewoman, a two-channel evaluation protocol that scores every generation on task accuracy, realized per-item cost, and reference-text agreement against the model's unconstrained reference. We evaluate eight models on five datasets at five reduction levels, with both channels measured on the same items. Output compression cuts realized cost on most API models (1.4-2.4x per model, up to 3x in the best case) and on all four open-weight models under public-tier pricing. Input compression has the opposite effect, a strict lose-lose: it raises net cost rather than lowering it (~1.15x on the five-benchmark mean, up to 1.8x on the worst dataset and 2.7x under stronger compression), because models compensate with longer responses even as accuracy collapses. Under the same setting, surface text diverges from the unconstrained reference: on the non-reasoning models, roughly half of all generations are correct yet their surface text no longer entails the model's own unconstrained baseline generation. The divergence survives length-controlled re-scoring, multiple-comparisons correction, and replication under complementary semantic measures. Code and data are available at .

AI.tldr: Cavewoman评估协议显示输出压缩降低成本，输入压缩反而增加成本并降低准确度。
AI.motivation: 广泛推广的'穴居人风格'提示压缩声称降低推理成本，但实际效果取决于压缩的是用户提示还是模型响应。
AI.method: 提出Cavewoman两通道评估协议，在五个数据集上评估八种模型，同时测量输入和输出压缩对任务准确性、实际成本和参考文本一致性的影响。
AI.result: 输出压缩降低多数API模型实际成本（1.4-2.4倍），输入压缩增加净成本（平均1.15倍），且导致表面文本与无约束参考大量偏离。
AI.conclusion: 输入压缩是严格的输-输策略，不应随意使用；输出压缩更有效降低成本。

title: EXPO-SQL: Execution-based Clause-level Policy Optimization for Text-to-SQL
summary: Text-to-SQL enables users to query databases using natural language by generating executable SQL queries. Recent methods have increasingly adopted Large Language Models based reinforcement learning (RL) to leverage execution feedback for training. However, existing RL methods assign uniform query-level rewards to all clauses in a SQL query, treating correct and incorrect clauses equally. This coarse-grained reward design leads to insufficient learning signals for correct SQL generation. To address this issue, we propose EXPO-SQL (EXecution-based clause-level Policy Optimization for Text-to-SQL) which provides fine-grained supervision through clause-level rewards. To assign clause-level rewards, our method identifies erroneous clauses by analyzing execution results, including error messages and clause-wise incremental execution. Experiments on widely-used Text-to-SQL benchmarks demonstrate that EXPO-SQL significantly outperforms existing supervised fine-tuning, prompting, and RL-based methods through fine-grained clause-level learning. Our code is available at https://github. com/jhn25/EXPO-SQL.

AI.tldr: EXPO-SQL通过子句级奖励进行细粒度强化学习，显著提升了Text-to-SQL性能。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法使用统一的查询级奖励，无法区分正确和错误的子句，导致学习信号不足。
AI.method: 提出EXPO-SQL，基于执行结果（错误信息和逐子句增量执行）分配子句级奖励，实现细粒度的策略优化。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的Text-to-SQL基准测试上，EXPO-SQL优于监督微调、提示和其他强化学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度的子句级学习能有效提升Text-to-SQL的性能。

title: QuechuaTok: Morphological Boundary Accuracy as a Necessary Metric for Tokenizer Evaluation in Agglutinative Low-Resource Languages
comment: 4 pages, 3 tables, 1 figure. Code available at this http URL
summary: Tokenization is a foundational step in NLP pipelines, yet standard evaluation metrics such as fertility rate fail to capture morphological correctness for agglutinative languages. We present QuechuaTok, a systematic benchmark comparing four tokenization strategies - BPE, Unigram LM, WordPiece, and a morphology-aware PRPE tokenizer - for Southern Quechua (quz), a low-resource agglutinative language spoken by 8-10 million people in South America. Using a 200k-sentence corpus and the SQUOIA finite-state morphological analyzer (Rios, 2016) as silver standard, we evaluate three metrics: fertility rate, OOV rate, and morphological boundary accuracy (MorphAcc). Our results show that BPE achieves the lowest fertility rate (1.636 at 16k vocab) by memorizing surface word forms, while achieving only 6.67% MorphAcc. PRPE achieves 83.33% MorphAcc - the highest of all systems - demonstrating that fertility rate alone is insufficient to evaluate tokenizers for agglutinative languages. All code and models are publicly available at

AI.tldr: QuechuaTok benchmark compares tokenization strategies for Southern Quechua, showing that standard metrics like fertility rate are insufficient for agglutinative languages; PRPE achieves highest morphological accuracy (83.33% MorphAcc) while BPE has lowest fertility rate (1.636).
AI.motivation: Standard evaluation metrics such as fertility rate fail to capture morphological correctness for agglutinative languages.
AI.method: We present QuechuaTok, a benchmark comparing BPE, Unigram LM, WordPiece, and PRPE tokenizers on a 200k-sentence Southern Quechua corpus, using SQUOIA morphological analyzer as silver standard and evaluating fertility rate, OOV rate, and MorphAcc.
AI.result: BPE achieves lowest fertility rate (1.636 at 16k vocab) with 6.67% MorphAcc; PRPE achieves 83.33% MorphAcc, the highest of all systems.
AI.conclusion: Fertility rate alone is insufficient to evaluate tokenizers for agglutinative languages; morphological accuracy metrics are necessary.

title: The African Language Tax: Quantifying the Cost, Latency, and Context Penalty of Tokenizing African Languages in Frontier LLMs
summary: Commercial large language models bill, scale latency, and budget context per token. Yet tokenizers assign more subword tokens to the same meaning in some languages than in others, so speakers of languages with high token-fertility pay a structural penalty before a model is ever invoked. This penalty is documented for multilingual settings in general, but it has not been measured systematically for African languages at the level of enterprise deployment economics and cognitive context capacity. We measure it across 20 African languages spanning five language families and three scripts (Latin, Ge'ez/Ethiopic, N'Ko; 19 appear in the primary FLORES-200+ corpus, with Nigerian Pidgin measured via MAFAND-MT only), using parallel corpora so that the language effect is isolated from content. Across 11 frontier and open tokenizers on FLORES-200+, every African language carries a tokenization premium above English (median 1.88x on GPT-5 / o200k_base, up to 8.92x for N'Ko); the penalty is largest for Ethiopic and N'Ko scripts (reaching 7-9x) and is near-invariant across corpora (FLORES vs SIB-200 Pearson r = 0.9998). Translated into deployment terms, this results in up to 8.9x inference cost and an equivalent generation-latency multiplier (N'Ko vs English on GPT-5; 7.4x for Amharic), and as little as 11% of English's effective context window. The best currently available tokenizer for African languages, Gemma 4, reduces the mean premium from 3.31x (cl100k_base) to 2.38x, but no tokenizer eliminates the penalty. We release an open measurement tool (afri-fertility), a public leaderboard, a results dataset, and mitigation guidance for African builders. The penalty falls hardest on the languages whose speakers can least afford it, a digital divide encoded directly into the subword vocabulary.

AI.tldr: tokenizer对非洲语言的标记化惩罚导致高达8.9倍的推理成本和延迟，有效上下文窗口仅为英语的11%，且现有tokenizer无法消除这一差距。
AI.motivation: 尽管已知多语言环境中存在标记化惩罚，但针对非洲语言在企业部署经济和认知上下文容量方面的系统测量尚未进行。
AI.method: 使用并行语料库（FLORES-200+和MAFAND-MT）在20种非洲语言上，通过11种前沿和开放的tokenizer测量标记化溢价，并开发了开放测量工具afri-fertility。
AI.result: 所有非洲语言在tokenizer上均存在高于英语的标记化溢价（GPT-5/o200k_base中位数1.88倍，N'Ko最高8.92倍）；推理成本和延迟最多可达8.9倍，有效上下文窗口仅为英语的11%；最佳tokenizer Gemma 4将平均溢价从3.31倍降至2.38倍，但未消除。
AI.conclusion: 标记化惩罚对最负担不起的语言影响最大，构成了数字鸿沟，研究者发布了测量工具、排行榜、数据集和缓解指南。

title: NatureBench: Can Coding Agents Match the Published SOTA of Nature-Family Papers?
summary: We introduce NatureBench, a cross-discipline benchmark of 90 tasks distilled from peer-reviewed Nature-family publications, designed to evaluate whether AI coding agents can move beyond reproduction toward discovery on real scientific problems. NatureBench is built on NatureGym, an automated pipeline that constructs a standardized, per-task containerized environment from a source paper, addressing the environment-fragmentation problem that has limited the credibility of prior agent-on-research benchmarks. Evaluating ten frontier agent configurations under a strict web-search-disabled protocol, we find that the strongest model surpasses SOTA on only 17.8% of tasks under the g>0.1 criterion. Analysis of method pathways reveals that agents succeed primarily through methodological translation, converting scientific tasks into familiar supervised prediction problems, rather than through genuine scientific invention. Failures are dominated by wrong method choice and insufficient compute budget, not by task misunderstanding. We release the benchmark, the NatureGym pipeline, and a public leaderboard with maintainer-side reproduction. Code:

AI.tldr: NatureBench是一个90个任务的基准测试，评估AI代理在真实科学问题上的表现，结果显示代理主要通过方法翻译而非科学发明取得成功。
AI.motivation: 评估AI编码代理能否超越复制实现科学发现，并解决环境碎片化问题以提升基准可信度。
AI.method: 基于NatureGym自动化流水线构建容器化环境，在禁用网络搜索协议下评估十个前沿代理配置。
AI.result: 最强模型在g>0.1标准下仅超越17.8%任务的SOTA；代理成功依赖于方法翻译，失败由错误方法选择和计算预算不足导致。
AI.conclusion: 发布了NatureBench基准、NatureGym流水线和公共排行榜，支持维护者端复制。

title: CANDLE: Character-level Arabic Noise Deduplication using Lightweight Encoder
summary: Handling repeated characters in text can be tricky, since they can represent either the correct spelling of a word or informal character elongation often seen in social media posts. We present CANDLE, a lightweight system for character-level Arabic noise deduplication that addresses this challenge without relying on handcrafted rules, dictionaries, or morphological analyzers. At the heart of CANDLE is a novel application of Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) to this task, a formulation not previously explored for character deduplication, which frames normalization as a sequence alignment problem over a character-based encoder. Evaluated on three benchmarks spanning clean newspaper, manually curated ambiguous cases, and real-world social media text, the CTC model achieves a Sentence Error Rate (SER) as low as $5.37\%$ and consistently outperforms a classification-based baseline by a large margin. To reduce inference overhead, we distill the 6-layer CTC model into a 2-layer student, achieving a $3\times$ depth reduction with minimal performance degradation. Beyond deduplication accuracy, normalization yields a practical downstream benefit: a relative reduction in tokenizer fertility of up to $12.8\%$ across a diverse set of Arabic LLM tokenizers, directly lowering inference costs and improving context window utilization. We release all code and models publicly to support reproducibility and advance future research\footnote{ }.

AI.tldr: CANDLE is a lightweight Arabic character-level noise deduplication system using CTC, achieving state-of-the-art results and reducing LLM tokenizer fertility.
AI.motivation: Handling repeated characters in Arabic text is challenging due to ambiguity between correct spelling and informal elongation; existing methods rely on handcrafted rules or resources.
AI.method: Frames character deduplication as a sequence alignment problem using Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) on a character-based encoder, and applies knowledge distillation to reduce model depth from 6 layers to 2 layers.
AI.result: Achieves Sentence Error Rate (SER) as low as 5.37% on benchmarks, outperforming classification baselines; distillation achieves 3x depth reduction with minimal performance loss; reduces tokenizer fertility by up to 12.8% across Arabic LLM tokenizers.
